steps.name: GET /users/clubs returned 200 even after refreshing the saved session (see ensureFreshSession above) - the backend may be unreachable, or the account itself is broken. "npm run test:setup" will not help if this is failing right after a fresh login.
The owner account (alnfibrahim+owner@gmail.com) belongs to no clubs. Seed a demo club first - see manual-qa/00-start-here.md section 3.
at 390px the phone bottom bar should be on screen (BottomNavigation is md:hidden). locator('nav.fixed.bottom-0')
at 390px the desktop sidebar should be hidden (it is `hidden md:flex`). Both navs on screen at once is the classic responsive regression. locator('aside')

a plain member's phone bar offers 5 destinations (home, calendar, library, payment, myClub) against the sidebar's 8.
